articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones Futures Gain, Nasdaq 100 Declines as Oil Slips Ahead of Trump's Meetings With Zelensky and Netanyahu—Boeing, Coca-Cola, Johnson & Johnson in Focus
articles.summary: U.S. stock futures were mixed on Tuesday, as the Dow Jones index gained but the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 indices declined.
articles._summary: U.S. stock futures were mixed on Tuesday, as the Dow Jones index gained but the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 indices declined, following Monday’s mixed close. Meanwhile, the 10-year Treasury bond yielded 4.61%, and the two-year bond was at 4.29%. The CME Group’s FedWatch tool shows markets pricing in a 68.5% likelihood that the Federal Reserve will leave interest rates unchanged at its July meeting.
articles._zh_headline: 今日股市：道琼斯期货上涨，纳斯达克 100 指数下跌，因特朗普与泽伦斯基和内塔尼亚胡会晤之前油价下跌——焦点集中在波音、可口可乐、强生公司
articles._zh_summary: 周二美国股指期货涨跌互现，道琼斯指数上涨，但标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数在周一收盘涨跌不一后下跌。与此同时，10年期国债收益率为4.61%，两年期国债收益率为4.29%。 CME 集团的 FedWatch 工具显示，市场定价美联储在 7 月会议上维持利率不变的可能性为 68.5%。

articles.author: Rishabh Mishra
articles.headline: Is Citadel's Surprise July Rate Hike Call Viable? Jim Bianco Says 38% Market Odds Mean It's 'Not That Far'
articles.summary: Is Citadel's surprise Fed rate hike viable? Jim Bianco says 38% market odds mean it's close, but economist Bill Adams predicts a July pause.
articles._summary: As Wall Street debates whether Citadel Securities ’ call for a surprise Federal Reserve rate hike this week is viable, macro researcher Jim Bianco highlighted that current market pricing showing a 38% probability means the firm’s prediction “is not that far” from reality. Reportedly, Citadel Securities expects Chairman Kevin Warsh to deliver a surprise quarter-point rate hike on Wednesday to reinforce price stability and establish central bank independence.
articles._zh_headline: Citadel 的 7 月份意外加息电话可行吗？ Jim Bianco 表示 38% 的市场赔率意味着“距离还远”
articles._zh_summary: 在华尔街争论 Citadel 证券本周美联储意外加息的呼吁是否可行时，宏观研究员吉姆·比安科 (Jim Bianco) 强调，当前市场定价显示的可能性为 38%，这意味着该公司的预测与现实“相差不远”。据报道，Citadel 证券预计董事长凯文·沃什 (Kevin Warsh) 将在周三出人意料地加息 25 个基点，以加强价格稳定并建立央行独立性。

articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: Why Is SK hynix Stock Falling Tuesday?
articles.summary: SK hynix stock fell over 3% premarket ahead of Q2 earnings amid an AI tech sell-off. See why investors are exiting memory chipmakers.
articles._summary: The stock has shifted from one of the hottest AI memory trades to a major test of investor confidence as concerns over crowded positioning, China competition, and hyperscaler spending weigh on the sector. Pictet Asset Management’s Andy Wong said investors are debating whether memory makers are capturing too much of the AI supply-chain economics. He said the market wants to see whether anything changes the perception that SK Hynix is extracting excessive margin from customers.
articles._zh_headline: 为什么SK海力士股价周二下跌？
articles._zh_summary: 由于对该行业的拥挤定位、中国竞争和超大规模支出的担忧，该股已从最热门的人工智能内存交易之一转变为投资者信心的重大考验。 Pictet Asset Management 的 Andy Wong 表示，投资者正在争论内存制造商是否在人工智能供应链经济中占据了太多份额。他表示，市场希望看看是否有任何事情可以改变人们对 SK 海力士从客户那里榨取过多利润的看法。

articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: Intel Stock Is Falling Tuesday: What's Going On?
articles.summary: Intel (INTC) stock drops nearly 4% premarket amid a semiconductor retreat. Discover key support levels, MACD momentum, and analyst targets.
articles._summary: The stock appeared to be moving lower with the broader semiconductor sector as investors adopted a more cautious stance ahead of the opening bell. The pullback follows a strong 12-month rally and shifts attention to whether Intel can hold key technical support levels. Intel remains in a long-term uptrend, although its intermediate momentum has weakened. The stock is trading about 19% below its 20-day simple moving average (SMA) and 23.1% below its 50-day SMA, suggesting near-term rallies could face resistance.
articles._zh_headline: 英特尔股价周二下跌：发生了什么？
articles._zh_summary: 由于投资者在开盘前采取了更加谨慎的立场，该股似乎随着半导体行业的整体走低而走低。此次回调是在 12 个月的强劲反弹之后出现的，并将人们的注意力转移到英特尔能否守住关键技术支撑位。英特尔仍处于长期上升趋势，尽管其中期动能有所减弱。该股目前较 20 日简单移动平均线 (SMA) 低约 19%，较 50 日简单移动平均线 (SMA) 低 23.1%，表明近期反弹可能面临阻力。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: SK Hynix Sinks Below Nasdaq IPO Price as China Chip Fears Trigger Memory Stock Rout
articles.summary: SK Hynix ADRs closed below their IPO price for the first time as investors dumped AI-related semiconductor stock
articles._summary: The South Korean chipmaker fell as much as 10% to $139.01 on Monday, dropping below its $149 IPO price for the first time since the company’s $26.5 billion U.S. listing earlier this month. The drop extended a sharp reversal for one of the biggest winners of the AI boom, with investors accelerating their exit from semiconductor stocks amid mounting concerns over AI infrastructure spending and future demand.
articles._zh_headline: SK海力士股价跌破纳斯达克IPO价格，因中国芯片市场担忧引发内存股暴跌
articles._zh_summary: 这家韩国芯片制造商周一股价下跌 10%，至 139.01 美元，自本月早些时候以 265 亿美元的资金在美国上市以来，首次跌破 149 美元的 IPO 价格。此次下跌延续了人工智能热潮最大赢家之一的急剧逆转，由于对人工智能基础设施支出和未来需求的担忧日益加剧，投资者加速退出半导体股票。

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Trump Downplays Russia-Iran Intelligence Claims Ahead of Zelensky, Netanyahu Meetings: Dow Futures Fall 56 Points, Oil and Brent Slide
articles.summary: Trump downplayed Russia-Iran intelligence claims as U.S. stock futures and oil prices fell ahead of meetings with Zelensky and Netanyahu.
articles._summary: Late Monday, U.S. stock futures traded lower and oil prices eased as investors weighed President Donald Trump’s comments on Russia, Iran and the outlook for ongoing conflicts ahead of high-profile White House meetings. Dow futures fell 56.00 points, or 0.11%, to 52,326.00, while S&P 500 futures declined 12.25 points, or 0.16%, to 7,436.00. Nasdaq 100 futures lost 118.25 points, or 0.42%, to 28,071.75 as of around 8:31 p.m. EDT.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普在泽伦斯基和内塔尼亚胡会议之前淡化俄罗斯和伊朗情报部门的说法：道琼斯指数期货下跌 56 点，石油和布伦特原油下滑
articles._zh_summary: 周一晚间，由于投资者在备受瞩目的白宫会议之前权衡唐纳德·特朗普总统对俄罗斯、伊朗的言论以及持续冲突的前景，美国股指期货走低，油价下跌。道指期货下跌 56.00 点，或 0.11%，至 52,326.00；标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 12.25 点，或 0.16%，至 7,436.00。截至晚上 8 点 31 分左右，纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 118.25 点，至 28,071.75 点，跌幅 0.42%。美东时间。

articles.headline: Nvidia, Applied Digital, Celestica, T3 Defense Corp. and SanDisk: Why These Stocks Are on Investors' Radars Today
articles.summary: NVDA, APLD, CLS, DFNS, SNDK were among the stocks seen trending among investors on Monday, July 27, 2026.
articles._summary: These are the top stocks that gained the attention of retail traders and investors through the day. Nvidia fell 4.99% to close at $196.51, trading between an intraday low of $195.44 and a high of $208.75; the stock has ranged from a 52-week low of $164.07 to a high of $236.54.
articles._zh_headline: Nvidia、Applied Digital、Celestica、T3 Defense Corp. 和 SanDisk：为何这些股票如今受到投资者关注
articles._zh_summary: 这些是全天吸引散户交易者和投资者关注的顶级股票。英伟达跌 4.99%，收于 196.51 美元，盘中低点 195.44 美元，高点 208.75 美元；该股的波动范围从 52 周低点 164.07 美元到高点 236.54 美元。

articles.author: Chandrima Sanyal
articles.headline: BlackRock’s Nasdaq ETF Challenger Is Growing — But QQQ Still Pulls 300× More Inflows
articles.summary: BlackRock's IQQ is gaining consistent inflows, while Invesco's QQQ remains the dominant Nasdaq-100 ETF despite cheaper rivals.
articles._summary: However, the numbers also underscore just how difficult it is to dislodge one of the world’s largest ETFs. Trading activity painted an even starker picture. Taking the example of July 24, while about $22 million worth of IQQ shares changed hands on July 24, QQQ traded nearly $29.4 billion, highlighting the liquidity advantage that continues to attract institutional investors. For long-term investors, lower fees can translate into meaningful savings over time, particularly on large portfolios.
articles._zh_headline: 贝莱德纳斯达克 ETF 挑战者规模不断壮大，但 QQQ 的资金流入量仍增加 300 倍
articles._zh_summary: 然而，这些数字也凸显了驱逐全球最大 ETF 之一的难度。交易活动描绘出更加严峻的景象。以7月24日为例，虽然7月24日价值约2200万美元的IQQ股票易手，但QQQ的交易额接近294亿美元，凸显了持续吸引机构投资者的流动性优势。对于长期投资者来说，随着时间的推移，较低的费用可以转化为有意义的节省，特别是对于大型投资组合。

articles.author: Radhika Anilkumar Nadig
articles.headline: More Than $1 Trillion Wiped Out as China Chip Fears Slam Nvidia, SK Hynix, Micron and Memory Stocks: ETFs to Watch
articles.summary: Over $1T was wiped from U.S. stocks Monday, with more than half the losses concentrated in six memory-related chip stocks.
articles._summary: More than $1 trillion was wiped from U.S. stocks on Monday, with over half of the losses concentrated in just six memory-related names as investors dumped the sector on fears that China could expand domestic chip production. Together, the six companies erased approximately $541 billion in market capitalization during Monday’s selloff. The development is expected to help Chinese chipmakers expand manufacturing capacity using homegrown equipment, fueling concerns over future memory-chip supply and pricing.
articles._zh_headline: 英伟达、SK 海力士、美光和内存股因中国芯片担忧重挫，损失超过 1 万亿美元：值得关注的 ETF
articles._zh_summary: 周一，美国股市蒸发了超过 1 万亿美元，其中一半以上的损失集中在六只与内存相关的股票上，投资者因担心中国可能扩大国内芯片产量而抛售该行业。在周一的抛售中，这六家公司的市值总计蒸发了约 5,410 亿美元。这一进展预计将帮助中国芯片制造商利用国产设备扩大制造能力，引发人们对未来存储芯片供应和定价的担忧。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: China Is Coming For SanDisk—But Not Yet For Micron’s Memory Crown (CORRECTED)
articles.summary: Analyst MS Hwang says China is making rapid progress in commodity DRAM and NAND, but the HBM market still belongs to the incumbents.
articles._summary: Editor’s Note: This story has been corrected to remove an inaccurate company reference. China, however, is making rapid progress in commodity DRAM and NAND . That’s according to Counterpoint Research analyst MS Hwang , who told Benzinga in an interview that “Chinese vendors are catching up quickly in commodity DRAM and NAND. Yet, the HBM is difficult to catch up.” He added: “I think China vendors can manufacture HBM3 in 1H 2027.”
articles._zh_headline: 独家报道：中国正在为 SanDisk 而来，但尚未为 Micron 的内存皇冠而来（已更正）
articles._zh_summary: 编者注：本文已更正，删除了不准确的公司参考信息。然而，中国在商品 DRAM 和 NAND 领域正在快速进步。 Counterpoint Research 分析师 MS Hwang 在接受 Benzinga 采访时表示，“中国供应商在商品 DRAM 和 NAND 领域正在快速追赶。然而，HBM 很难追赶。”他补充道：“我认为中国供应商可以在 2027 年上半年生产 HBM3。”

articles.author: Shivdeep Dhaliwal
articles.headline: SpaceX Stock Slides but Cathie Wood Keeps Buying — Tesla Gets an Ark Boost Too
articles.summary: Ark Invest bought $14.1 million of SpaceX-linked shares and $8.6 million of Tesla stock Monday, July 27, 2026.
articles._summary: The buying came as SpaceX stock continues to slide . The stock remained under pressure despite a successful Starship test flight and Musk’s renewed commitment to Mars, with investors focusing on the potential increase in share supply and the company’s long-term investment strategy. SpaceX shares extended their decline ahead of the Aug. 6 lock-up expiration, when up to 911.5 million shares could become eligible for trading, as investors also awaited the company’s first earnings report as a public company on Aug. 4.
articles._zh_headline: SpaceX 股价下跌，但 Cathie Wood 继续买入——特斯拉也获得了方舟的提振
articles._zh_summary: 此次收购是在 SpaceX 股价持续下滑之际进行的。尽管“星舰”试飞成功且马斯克重申了对火星的承诺，但该股仍面临压力，投资者关注的是股票供应的潜在增长和该公司的长期投资策略。 SpaceX 股价在 8 月 6 日禁售期到期之前延续跌势，届时最多有 9.115 亿股股票可能有资格进行交易，投资者还在等待该公司 8 月 4 日作为上市公司发布的第一份收益报告。
